help.building.tile.descr.5: There are 3 different types of buildings: houses, <tower>watchtowers</tower>, and <castle>castles</castle>.
help.building.tile.descr.6: There are 3 different types of buildings: <house>houses</house>, watchtowers and <castle>castles</castle>.
help.building.tile.descr.7: There are 3 different types of buildings: <house>houses</house>, <tower>watchtowers</tower>, and castles.
help.building.tile.5.descr: A house is worth 1 point per house tile, plus any bonuses from longships
help.building.tile.5.capture: Each time you place a Viking adjacent to a house, you take a tile from that house.
help.building.tile.6.descr: A watchtower is worth 2 points per watchtower tile, plus any bonuses from longships
help.building.tile.6.capture: When you connect two watchtowers with Vikings of your color, you take one tile from each of those two watchtowers. You can capture the same watchtower multiple times <bold>but only</bold> if you connect it to a <bold>new</bold> watchtower.
help.building.tile.7.descr: A castle is worth 4 points per castle tile, plus any bonuses from longships
help.building.tile.7.capture: When you form a chain of 4 Vikings of your color, at least one of which is adjacent to a castle, you capture a tile from that castle. To capture another tile from that castle, your chain must increase to 8 Vikings, and to 12 Vikings to capture a final tile.
help.construction.site.tile.descr.1: As you collect resources and buildings, you can place them to complete one of your three construction sites.
help.construction.site.tile.descr.2: To complete a construction site, you must have the required resources and buildings adjacent to the construction site.
help.construction.site.tile.descr.3: When you complete a construction site, turn its tile over to the illustration side.
help.construction.site.tile.note: <bold>Note</bold>: Resources and buildings are freely arranged around the construction site.
help.construction.site.tile.explain: This construction site tile is a {type, select, 1{Seaport} 2{Altar of the Deities} other{Jarl's Palace}} tile and is worth {type, select, 1{5} 2{7} other{9}} points when flipped over
help.construction.site.tile.resources: To complete this construction site, you need:
help.fjord.descr: The fjord board corresponds to your player board, this is where you will place the resource, building and longship tiles that you have collected.
help.fjord.scoring.wood: each wood tile is worth 1 point, plus any bonuses from the longships
help.fjord.scoring.sheep: each sheep tile is worth 1 point, plus any bonuses from the longships
help.fjord.scoring.gold: each gold tile is worth 2 points, plus any bonuses from the longships
help.fjord.scoring.house: each house tile is worth 1 point, plus any bonuses from the longships
help.fjord.scoring.watchtower: each watchtower tile is worth 2 points, plus any bonuses from the longships
help.fjord.scoring.castle: each castle tile is worth 4 points, plus any bonuses from the longships
help.fjord.scoring.seaport: The Seaport construction site is worth 5 points once completed
help.fjord.scoring.altar: The Altar of the Deities construction site is worth 7 points once completed.
help.fjord.scoring.jarl: The Jarl's Palace construction site is worth 9 points once completed.
help.fjord.scoring.trophy: The collected trophy earns the number of points indicated.
help.fjord.scoring.drakkar: Each unfilled longship loses 5 victory points
help.landscape.descr.1: The landscape tiles make up the main board.
help.landscape.descr.2: Each turn, you must place one of your Vikings on the main board, respecting the following placement rules:
help.landscape.rule.1: It must be placed on a resource space that does not contain any Vikings.
help.landscape.rule.2: It must be adjacent to another Viking (regardless of color) or a Longship.
help.landscape.descr.3: Then take the corresponding resource from the reserve and place it on an empty space in your fjord. This resource cannot be moved.
help.landscape.descr.4: If you have no more Vikings, you pass your turn.
help.longship.tile.descr.1: At the end of your turn, you may choose <bold>one and only one</bold> longship.
help.longship.tile.descr.2: Then place it on an empty square in your fjord.
help.longship.tile.descr.3: Each longship provides a bonus to a resource or building when filled. To fill a longship, you must have the three requested resources adjacent to the longship.
help.longship.tile.descr.4: Once the longship has been filled, turn it over to display the bonus it gives you.
help.longship.tile.note: Note: Resources are freely arranged around the longship.
help.longship.tile.explain: This longship earns, once filled, {value, plural, one{# point} other{# points}} per {type, select, 1{castle} 2{gold} 3{watchtower} 4{sheep} 5{wood} other{house}} tile present on your board.
help.longship.tile.resources: To fill this longship, you need:
help.longship.tile.warning: Warning! At the end of the game, each unfilled longship loses 5 victory points.
help.ocean.descr: The ocean tile makes up the main board, it also accommodates the longship tiles.
help.trophy.board.descr: The trophy tile makes up the main board, it also houses the trophies.
help.resource.tile.descr.1: There are 4 different types of resources: wood, <sheep>sheep</sheep>, <gold>gold</gold>, and <axe>axes</axe>.
help.resource.tile.1.descr: wood earns 1 point per wood tile, plus any bonuses from longships
help.resource.tile.descr.2: There are 4 different types of resources: <wood>wood</wood>, sheep, <gold>gold</gold>, and <axe>axes</axe>.
help.resource.tile.2.descr: sheep are worth 1 point per sheep tile, plus any bonuses from longships
help.resource.tile.descr.3: There are 4 different types of resources: <wood>wood</wood>, <sheep>sheep</sheep>, gold, and <axe>axes</axe>.
help.resource.tile.3.descr: gold earns 2 points per gold tile, plus any bonuses from longships
help.resource.tile.descr.4: There are 4 different types of resources: <wood>wood</wood>, <sheep>sheep</sheep>, <gold>gold</gold>, and axes.
help.resource.tile.4.descr: Axes do not earn any points, but they do earn you a trophy.
help.shield.descr.1: When you place a Viking, you can also use one or more of your shields.
help.shield.descr.2: Each shield is single-use and gives you an advantage when you use it.
help.shield.descr.3: Once the shield is used, it is flipped to indicate that it will no longer be available for the remainder of the game.
help.shield.bonus.1: Immediately place a second Viking, following the placement rules.
help.shield.bonus.2: When you place your Viking, gain two resources instead of one.
help.shield.bonus.3: Place your Viking on a resource space where another Viking is.
help.trophy.descr.1: At the end of your turn, you can take a trophy.
help.trophy.descr.2: Please note, you can only take one trophy for the entire game and each trophy is unique.
help.trophy.descr.3: To take a trophy, you must have <bold>at least as many axes</bold> as indicated on the trophy, regardless of where they are in your fjord.
help.trophy.explain: This trophy is worth {value} points and requires at least {nbHaches} axes.
help.viking.descr.1: Each turn, you must place one of your Vikings on the main board, respecting the following placement rules:
help.viking.rule.1: It must be placed on a resource space that does not contain any Vikings.
help.viking.rule.2: It must be adjacent to another Viking (regardless of color) or a Longship.
help.viking.descr.2: Then take the corresponding resource from the reserve and place it on an empty space in your fjord. This resource cannot be moved.
help.viking.descr.3: If you have no more Vikings, you pass your turn.
help.viking.descr.4: The game ends when no player has any more Vikings to place.
help.scorepad.descr.1: Once all the Vikings have been played, it's time to crown the next Jarl.
help.scorepad.descr.2: Using the scorepad, each player calculates their victory points as follows:
help.scorepad.list.1: Add to the <bold>starting value</bold> of your castles any <bold>castle bonuses</bold> you own. Then multiply this value by the <bold>number of castles</bold> you own.
help.scorepad.list.2: Repeat this process for your <bold>watchtowers</bold>, your <bold>houses</bold>, your <bold>gold</bold>, your <bold>sheep</bold>, and your <bold>wood</bold>.
help.scorepad.list.3: Add up the victory points of the construction sites you have <bold>completed</bold>.
help.scorepad.list.4: Add the points of your possible trophy.
help.scorepad.list.5: Finally, for each longship you have not filled, <bold>lose 5 victory points</bold>.
help.scorepad.descr.3: The player with the most points wins the game and becomes Jarl of all Vikings.
help.scorepad.descr.4: In the event of a tie, the player with the <bold>most powerful trophy</bold> wins the game.

tuto.step.1:
This is your <bold>fjord</bold>. On this personal board, you will collect resources and captured buildings to earn victory points.
At the end of the game, the richest player will become the Jarl of all Vikings!
tuto.step.2:
Here are your <bold>Vikings</bold>: Each turn, you will send one (or two) Vikings on an expedition.
The game ends when players run out of Vikings.
tuto.step.3: And here is the main board. It is randomly generated each game!
tuto.step.4:
Here are the 5 <bold>longships</bold>: the invasion starts here!
On your turn, you must place a Viking on a space <bold>adjacent to a longship or Viking</bold> already placed.
tuto.step.5: Place your Viking on this square.
tuto.step.6: When you place a Viking, you gain a resource tile corresponding to its space. Here, you have placed your Viking on a battlefield, you gain an <bold>axe</bold> tile.
tuto.step.7:
The tiles you win go to any empty space in your fjord.
Place your <bold>axe</bold> tile on that space.
tuto.step.8:
There are three construction sites in your fjord: the <bold>Seaport</bold>, the <bold>Altar of the Deities</bold>, and the <bold>Jarl's Palace</bold>.
These construction sites are worth <bold>5, 7, and 9 points</bold> once completed.
To complete them, you must place the resources and buildings they require around them.
tuto.step.9: By placing your <bold>axe</bold> tile here, you already fulfill a requirement of your <bold>Altar of the Deities</bold>.
tuto.step.10: By placing Vikings, you can also collect <bold>building</bold> tiles: houses, watchtowers, and castles.
tuto.step.11:
To get a <bold>house</bold>, simply place a Viking next to it!
Take this house and place it on this space of your fjord.
tuto.step.12: At the end of your turn, you can also take a longship tile and place it in your fjord.
tuto.step.13:
Longship tiles allow you to earn more victory points, provided you can fill them: each longship requires 3 resources, which must be placed adjacent to the longship in your fjord.
<bold>Be careful, an unfilled longship loses you 5 points at the end of the game!</bold>
tuto.step.14: Place this longship in your fjord, on this space.
tuto.step.15: The longship you just took requires two <bold>axe</bold> tiles and one <bold>gold</bold> tile. You already have one <bold>axe</bold> tile next to it.
tuto.step.16: If you fill it, you will earn 1 point for each <bold>watchtower</bold> tile in your fjord.
tuto.step.18: Your opponent has taken the second house tile from this location. There are only two house tiles to take from each pile.
tuto.step.19: Your move. Place your Viking here, on the gold.
tuto.step.20: Place the recovered gold here, in your fjord.
tuto.step.21: You have just placed a Viking near a watchtower. By connecting two watchtowers with a line of Vikings of your color, you collect one tile from each watchtower.
tuto.step.22: At the end of your turn, you can take a longship tile again if you wish.
tuto.step.23: Some longship tiles, with a black background, are more powerful. For example, once filled, this tile will give you 2 points per <bold>watchtower</bold> tile in your fjord. The longship you captured in the previous turn is worth 1 point per watchtower.
tuto.step.24: Take this tile and place it here.
tuto.step.25: Your opponent will now play their second turn.
tuto.step.26:
It's your turn. It's time to collect watchtowers!
Place your Viking here to connect the two watchtowers with your Vikings.
tuto.step.27: Now, place your two watchtowers near your <bold>Altar of the Deities</bold>. You'll only need one more sheep to complete it.
tuto.step.29: You have filled this longship by placing 2 axes and 1 gold around it! The tile is automatically turned over, and will earn you 1 point per watchtower at the end of the game.
tuto.step.30: At the end of your turn, once in the game, you can also take a <bold>trophy</bold>.
tuto.step.31:
Currently, you only have two <bold>axe</bold> tiles in your fjord; only this trophy is available. It's worth 3 points.
You might be able to get a more powerful trophy if you wait a bit!
tuto.step.32:
The game ends after all the Vikings have been played. Players then add up their victory points:
• 2 points per gold, 1 point per sheep and per wood
• 4 points per castle, 2 points per watchtower, and 1 point per house
• 5, 7, and 9 points for completed construction sites
• Trophy points and filled longships
• -5 points per unfilled longship
tuto.step.33:
To surprise your opponents, you also have these 3 single-use shields!
Use them before placing a Viking to:
• place a second Viking in the same turn
• place your Viking on an already occupied space
• harvest the resource twice with your Viking
tuto.step.34: Now it's your turn, may Odin and Thor be with you!
